eps.d: Cory Matthews gets detention after school for trying to listen to a Philadelphia Phillies baseball game in class while his teacher—Mr. Feeny—teaches the class the great value that love has in all of their lives, using Romeo and Juliet as a guide.

Cory learns the value of a dollar when his parents will not buy him an expensive water gun for the neighborhood water gun "fight". He soon strikes up a deal with Mr. Feeny: Cory will paint Mr. Feeny's shutters, and be paid the money needed to buy a new watergun.
When Alan lets Cory stay up late to watch a baseball game, a no-hitter, Cory falls asleep in class the next day at school, and fails a test — which Mr. Feeny refuses to let him make up.
Cory decides that he wants to change his hairstyle, but it takes a turn for the worse, leading him to join a group of social outcasts.
When Cory finds out that the winner of a Geography Bee will be a batboy at the World Series, he tries to bribe Minkus into relinquishing his spot in the contest.

Cory cheats on an I.Q. test, and is labeled the smartest kid in class. However, the consequences for getting away with it are worse than getting caught; Cory may be transferred into a new school for smart kids.
Alan's mother (Rue McClanahan) arrives, gives Cory a Cal Ripken rookie card, and promises to get it autographed by "the man in the picture".

When Cory insists that teaching is easy, in comparison to learning, Mr. Feeny agrees to a bet; Cory and Mr. Feeny temporarily switch roles, with Cory teaching social studies for one week, while Feeny is a student.
Cory's dream to be a big-league baseball star is crushed by Mr. Feeny when the class is assigned to envision its 20th reunion and is given a grade of "Incomplete".
Shawn's father loses his job, and Cory vows that Shawn will have a Christmas gift this year.

The father/son softball game is coming up, but Cory and Eric do not want to play. Alan finds out how they really feel about the game, and he tells them that the game was canceled, but Cory finds out (from Topanga) that the game, in fact, was played.
While Cory is working on a difficult math problem, he chances upon another conundrum: he accidentally discovers provocative clothing in his mother's bag, and assumes that she is having an affair.

eps.t: She Loves Me, She Loves Me Not
eps.d: Topanga develops a crush on Eric, but Cory gets the impression that her affections are directed at him.
Cory and Minkus are assigned to the basketball "B-Team" at school, and rarely get to play. However, Cory also gets the feeling that he is on the "B-Team" with his own family.
Cory learns that there is no such thing as "a perfect family" when he is assigned to get in a group with Shawn, Topanga and Minkus and work together as a family.
Cory and Shawn bet on racehorses for a school project, but they soon learn—the hard way—that there are things in life that are not worth risking.

Shawn is afraid of getting into trouble after a cherry bomb prank gone wrong—he blew up Alan Matthews' supermarket's mailbox, so he runs away from home, and asks Cory if he can stay in his room in secrecy.

Cory and Shawn try to sneak an 'R'-rated movie into the house when the family will be out, but their plans are put in jeopardy when Mr. Feeny becomes their babysitter. Eric has failed his driving test, but he still decides to drive.
For Cory's birthday, Alan gives him a necklace with two silver boxing gloves on it, but Cory belittles his gift, and carelessly loses it.
Cory quits the school production of Hamlet after learning he has to wear tights. Minkus replaces him, but is a poor substitute.

After watching a class video about hormones in both males and females, Shawn goes on a date with a cute classmate named Hilary. Cory doesn't understand the appeal of dating, but asks Topanga out anyway, in an attempt to keep up with his buddy.
Cory is nervous about a big geography test and wishes Mr. Feeny would get sick for just one day. When Cory's wish comes true and Mr. Feeny goes to the hospital, Cory is racked with guilt.

Cory, Shawn, and Topanga are starting high school. Eric makes them a guide to John Adams High School, on the condition that they don't speak to him during school hours. However, a simple manual does not make Cory's first day perfect, as he quickly runs into the school bullies, led by Harley Keiner. When he accidentally gets Harley into trouble with the new high school principal, Mr.

Cory realizes that everyone at school, even Shawn, has paired off into couples. When he unexpectedly discovers one of Eric's secrets, he forces him to give advice on "how to get a girl to say hi." However, taking advice from Eric may prove to be a mistake.

Eric is going out with a senior who uses him to get what she wants. Meanwhile, Shawn wants to make a name for himself, so he changes a headline in the school paper to say that "New Principal is Weeny." But when a witness places Cory at the scene of the crime, he must choose between turning in his friend or facing suspension.

When the staff lies to Cory's class about an upcoming test, Cory attempts to use what he learned in The Grapes of Wrath by launching a student protest. However, he soon learns the lesson hidden in the novel: there is a price to pay for doing what you think is right.

Cory thinks he's cool when he's invited to his first high school party by the exclusive-minded Melissa, but surprisingly a more popular Shawn is not on the guest list. Now, he will learn the true meaning of friendship.
In this Halloween episode, Cory gets bitten by a runaway "wolf." Unfortunately, he starts getting symptoms which a fortune teller says may be signs that he is turning into a werewolf.

When the class cannot understand Much Ado About Nothing , Mr. Turner launches a new controversial project: he asks his students to videotape each other with their views on love and sex. However, when Cory and Topanga stay overnight at the school to finish their project, they themselves become a scandal story, angering Topanga.

Cory and Shawn pretend that they're in a band so that they can impress girls. This inspires Alan to connect with his former bandmates. But while this creates some problems for him, Cory and Shawn face a bigger dilemma: they are accidentally booked as the entertainment for the school dance.
Cory and Shawn go to a make-out party. But when Cory cannot get through "seven minutes in heaven" with Topanga, he becomes the laughingstock of the school.
Cory wins a girl's heart with a little politeness – but he better stay respectful, because she's Harley Keiner's kid sister, Theresa, also known as "T.K.", who never takes no for an answer.
When Shawn cannot decide between two girls, he asks Cory to date one of them while he gets to know the other. However, Cory falls for the girl he's supposed to "hold" for Shawn.

A "turnaround" dance gives girls a chance to ask guys out, but that does not take any pressure off Cory, who now worries about who'll ask him, if anyone. Very unfortunately for Cory, it may turn out to be a dance abundant in rejection.

Cory and Shawn help Frankie express his feelings to a schoolmate, who turns out to be Harley's girlfriend. Also, Alan makes a bad choice for his anniversary present. Now, they must all learn what women want.
Shawn nominates Cory for class president and manages the campaign. But will Cory keep his cool when his initial campaign platform of honesty collapses, or will he just become another "politician"?

eps.t: Breaking Up is Really, Really Hard to Do
eps.d: Cory gets a date for a "couples" party. Shawn nudges him to end the relationship before it goes on too long. But Cory cannot find the nerve to dump her. Will they be stuck together forever?

When Eric's girlfriend's younger cousin comes to town, Eric asks Shawn – instead of Cory – out on a double date, angering Cory and leading him to confront Eric in front of the girls. Also, Mr. Feeny is insulted when the staff assumes he wants to head the most boring club. After Cory and Feeny have a talk about how offended they are by Eric and Mr.

The school's radio station is so boring! Cory and Shawn can't even make it more interesting until they hit on the one thing that really gets people's attention: "Lunchtime Lust." Will the teachers let them get away with it? Meanwhile, Eric enters a magazine sweepstakes.

An attractive history tutor helps Eric prepare for a test that might raise his grade average enough to allow him to go on a school trip to Europe, then offers to help him cheat because she finds him attractive.

A demoralized (disheartned) Shawn hangs out with Harley Keiner and his thugs, much to Cory and Mr. Turner's dismay when he gets dumped by a nice girl, while Eric gets a dream skating lesson from Nancy Kerrigan.
Shawn and Cory accidentally discover the date and topic of a forthcoming test. Frankie and Joey search for a new leader after being rejected by Harley Keiner, the replacement Griff Hawkins.
Cory may finally have an extracurricular activity to list in the yearbook after he's bullied into joining the high school's wrestling team by Griff Hawkins and his band of thugs.
Shawn is left feeling like a fifth wheel in Cory's house when his mother drives off with the family's mobile home and his father leaves to track her down.

After staying with Cory's family for three weeks and not exactly fitting in, Shawn searches for a more permanent home. Meanwhile, Feeny takes advantage of the fact that Eric needs help to study for SATs by making him do yard work.
Topanga returns from summer camp a woman; Cory tries to gather the courage to ask Topanga out.
Shawn scores a date with one of the most sought after girls at John Adams High but problems abound when Shawn has to stay at the Matthew's while Mr. Turner is out of town.
Cory catches Topanga off guard when he tells her that he loves her.
After being caught skipping class, Shawn is sent to the guidance counselor where he misreads something she says and decides to drop out of school.
Cory and Shawn break into the school to turn in their papers they end up starting a fire in the chemistry lab.
Shawn and Topanga disagree over Shawn keeping a pig he found in the city.
Cory and Shawn's media project exposes Janitor Bud padding his time card leading to his firing.
Eric and Cory plan a rave at Chubbie's on the same date as their parent's anniversary.
Cory basks in the attention he gets from girls now that he and Topanga are an item.
The gang tries to celebrate New Year's Eve but end up stuck on a subway train.
Cory and Shawn sneak off to Mr. Feeny's cabin for some mischief.
Cory realizes that he is in a rut with Topanga and heads to a party at another school with Shawn.
Frankie tries to befriend Cory and Shawn.

eps.t: A Kiss is More Than a Kiss
eps.d: Shawn encourages a reluctant Cory to remove on after his breakup with Topanga.

eps.t: The Heart is a Lonely Hunter
eps.d: Shawn gets shot down by a nice girl who would prefer to date Cory.
Eric decides to quit school to work full time at the station; Mr. Turner begins dating Shawn's girlfriend's mom.
Cory catches a thief stealing stuff at Shawn's trailer park and wants to submit it for a contest but the thief has ties to Shawn.
The students of John Adams High are upset with the final exam schedule which Mr. Feeny refuses to alter.
A freak accident sends Cory to 1957 where he is mistaken for a Russian spy.

eps.t: I Never Sang for My Legal Guardian
eps.d: Shawn grows increasing frustrated with his father's lack of presence while Mr. Turner takes steps to become Shawn's legal guardian.
After being broken up for several months and Cory dating numerous other girls, Cory finally realizes that Topanga is the one for him and sets out to win her back at Disney World.
With graduation looming, Eric awaits an acceptance letter after being wait listed by a school in California. Cory finds out that both Shawn and Topanga have summer plans.
After road tripping across the county all summer, Cory is ready to go home but Eric is resistant.
Topanga tries to prove a point to Cory that looks don't matter but she ends up becoming obsessed with her looks.

eps.t: I Ain't Gonna Spray Lettuce No More
eps.d: Alan decides to quit his job without discussing it with Amy.
Shawn's mother finally returns to town; Cory is upset when the beloved school lunch lady passes away.
Eric begins dating a constantly perky musician, when they break up she goes dark and writes a song about Eric.
Shawn's father finally gets full-time employment....as a janitor at school.
Cory gets his tonsils taken out; Eric is selected to appear on the MTV dating show, 'Singled Out'.
Shawn helps a friend who is being abused by her father.
Cory has conflicting obligations when helping Frankie at his father's wrestling match coincides with Topanga's birthday party.
Cory and Shawn convince their families to have Thanksgiving dinner together.
Shawn gets back together with a very pretty and popular girl but she wants him to dump Cory.
Cory gets a job at a local restaurant but quits when he finds out that it is run by the mafia but Shawn doesn't have the same concerns and takes the job.
With Mr. Feeny out of town, Shawn turns his home into a bed and breakfast; Eric attends an out of town convention for the store.
Cory disappoints Alan when he goes to get his license without him.
In order to get a better understanding of what girls think and feel, Cory and Shawn go undercover.
Eric sees Shawn and Topanga hug and kiss at Chubbie's, when Cory confronts the two he learns that the truth is much worse.
Cory has trouble adjusting now that Topanga has moved to Pittsburgh.
Eric begins dating a girl who has a young son.
Cory and Shawn fill in on a game show Topanga has been selected to appear on, they end up becoming so popular the game show becomes less about smarts and more about pop culture knowledge.
Alan fires Eric from the store after he messes up again; Mr. Feeny is concerned that Eric is wasting his potential.
Shawn ends up being recruited into a cult; Mr. Turner is an accident.
Cory and Shawn accompany Eric to Beach State; Mr. Feeny encourages Eric to consider Pennbrook.
Eric screws up his housing at Pennbrook; Shawn's half-brother ends up as Eric's new roommate.
Cory makes a documentary about Shawn, Jack and Eric living together.
Cory and Shawn have a fight after Shawn finds out Cory applied to Stanford; Eric and Jack stress out their first college paper.
Eric and Jack start their own fraternity; Shawn starts skipping school to attend a college class.
Eric believes the girl that Jack is seeing is a witch.
Salem the cat transports Cory back to the 1940's where he goes off to fight in World War II.
Shawn seeks the owner of a purse he found thinking the owner is his soul mate.
Shawn finds out that the items in the purse belong to Angela.
Cory becomes jealous when Shawn does better than him at a work study program; Eric is upset when Amy enrolls in his creative writing class.
Cory and Shawn are jealous when Topanga and Angela go out with their new co-workers.
Topanga spends Christmas with the Matthews and brings her various holiday traditions with her.
Cory is upset when Alan doesn't want to do fun activities with him; Alan realizes that he needs to relate better to both his sons.
Mr. Feeny tired of Shawn's lazy attitude, Cory's obsession with taking responsibility of Shawn and Topanga butting in on everything gives the three a task to complete in a week.
At the senior class ski trip, Cory sprains his ankle forcing him to spend the trip in the ski lounge where he gets to close to the girl working the front desk.
Cory and Topanga split when Topanga finds the letter Lauren wrote to Cory; Shawn's ex-girlfriends spring a trap on him.

eps.t: Torn Between Two Lovers (Feeling Like a Fool)
eps.d: Shawn works at getting Topanga and Cory back together when Lauren shows up.
The group ends up with detention where they are picked off one by one.

eps.t: If You Can't Be with the One You Love...
eps.d: Cory and Shawn get drunk at a party. Cory promises to never drink again but Shawn discovers he likes the taste.
Eric is spotted by a Hollywood executive after appearing in a college play; Topanga takes care of Shawn and Jack when they get chicken pox.
Topanga meets a boy who test the limits of her getting back together with Cory.
Cory and Topanga keep their reconciliation a secret so Shawn will think he was the one that got them back together.
Cory has big plans for his and Topanga's prom night; Alan and Amy making a surprising announcement.
With all the upcoming changes in his life, Cory begins to freak out.
The group is getting ready to graduate and Mr. Feeny assigns them one last assignment about what they are feeling the last few weeks of school before graduation.
Cory is shocked by Topanga's proposal; Their family and friend's having conflicting views on their engagement.
Topanga decides she can't go through with an elopement.
Cory decides that he is too mediocre and signs up for the hardest classes possible.
Angela rebuffs Cory's show of friendship after she and Shawn split; Mr. Feeny returns to Philadelphia and beings taking classes at Pennbrook.
Cory stresses out when he meets a child art prodigy and blames his parents for his mediocrity.
Cory becomes jealous when Shawn and Topanga kiss for a college video.
After a professor makes an inappropriate advance on Topanga, Cory hits the professor.
Cory loses his engagement ring when he accompanies Shawn to a club where the women dress in scantily clad clothing.

eps.t: Poetic License: An Ode to Holden Caulfield
eps.d: Shawn begins writing poetry when Cory interferes and reads a poem that Shawn wrote about Angela.

eps.t: And in Case I Don't See Ya
eps.d: Eric tries to be more popular by setting up a reality show in his apartment without Rachel or Jack's knowledge; Cory and Shawn take advantage of Mr. Feeny's friendship.
Cory tries to play matchmaker after finding out the both Shawn and Angela still have feelings for one another; Eric plays a mall Santa and takes it to the extreme.
Alan has a midlife crisis; Shawn and Angela try to move on.

eps.t: We'll Have a Good Time Then
eps.d: Shawn and Jack's dad blows back into town.
Cory and Topanga play "The Fiance Game" with Eric and Rachel; Shawn and Jack deal with the aftermath of their dad's death.
Shawn and Cory hit the road; Things are awkward between Jack and Rachel after they kiss.
Topanga wants to throw a baby shower for Amy on Valentine's Day but Cory ruins it; Jack and Rachel worry about tell Eric about their relationship.
Baby Joshua fights for his life; Topanga and Cory disagree on their current attitudes towards a serious situation.

eps.t: Can I Help to Cheer You?
eps.d: Tommy wants Eric to adopt him but another family is interested in him that lives in California; Topanga and Cory attend a wedding to get ideas for their own.
The gang tries to help Mr. Feeny impress Dean Bolander; Jack is self conscious about his and Rachel's height difference.
Cory takes this to far when he begins being honest with Topanga about everything; Eric uses Joshua to get women.
Cory has nightmares where he is killing Shawn; Eric needs to find a new place to live.
Topanga's parents come to visit and reveal they are having problems in their marriage; Mr. Feeny marries Dean Bolander.
After spending the summer apart, Cory is hopeful that Topanga will be ready to reunite but Topanga ends things for good.
Cory and Shawn travel to Pittsburgh to try and convince Topanga's parents to get back together; Jack and Eric challenge the girls to a wrestling match over the apartment.
Angela's father arrives to recruit members for the ROTC program; Eric plots his revenge on Topanga.

eps.t: No Such Thing as a Sure Thing
eps.d: Eric and Jack place bets on the college football game thinking their best player won't be able to play; Topanga finally realizes she is meant to be with Cory.
Cory and Shawn impose on the girl's apartment upsetting Rachel; Jack and Eric become managers of the student union.
Cory and Topanga try to navigate the ups and downs of planning their wedding.
Cory and Topanga's wedding day has arrived; Shawn freaks out over Cory and his friendship changing.
Cory and Topanga love the island they honeymoon at they decide to move their permanently.
Cory and Topanga return from their honeymoon to find they have no place to live.
Cory and Topanga try to make their apartment a home; Jack and Eric get a new boss at the student union.
Cory redecorates the apartment; Jack and Eric have to pretend to be women in order to hide from a guy on campus.
Shawn finds out that Verna is not his biological mother.
Cory and Topanga get into their first big fight ever.

eps.t: I'm Gonna Be Like You, Dad
eps.d: Eric rejoins Alan at the outdoor store but Amy and Mr. Feeny are not happy that Alan has taken him back; Cory freaks out over a low score on a magazine health test.
A prank war between the group of friends get out of control.
Mr. Feeny tries to help the group reconcile after their prank war goes to far; Eric has a glimpse into what with happen if they all go their separate ways.

eps.t: She's Having My Baby Back Ribs
eps.d: Cory gets the wrong idea when Topanga goes on a diet assuming she is pregnant.

eps.t: How Cory and Topanga Got Their Groove Back
eps.d: Cory and Topanga attempt to through a party when they think they are stuck in a rut.
Eric and Cory get into an argument while trying to sell items at their parents garage sale.
Topanga is stressed out about a paper due at school, she is envisions a 1940's style murder mystery.
Angela's father finds out that he is being reassigned to Europe for a year and he asks Angela to go with him.
Topanga is offered an internship that requires her and Cory to move to New York.
As all the friends say goodbye to each other they all make one last stop to Mr. Feeny's Classroom for their last goodbye to Mr.Feeny where he gives them his very last piece of advice.
